CD4 T-cells in HIV-infected individuals have a reduced capacity to control M. tuberculosis, which is due to a combination of reduced CD4 T-cell number and reduced CD4 T cell function.

there are multiple pathways that are altered by HIV infection that contribute to TB reactivation in HIV-TB co-infections.
